content:
Alex Kim: heads-up — i'm opening a small PR to move the function-calling examples into the new snippets/ directory. not changing text, just file layout.
Priya Nair: thanks. can you also update the python/js SDK snippets to use the new `client.callTool()` pattern? that's what the v2 sdk uses now.
Alex Kim: yep planning to. grabbing the latest js shim from @Sam first.
Sam Ortiz: pushed a tiny helper to the SDK branch — use `invokeTool({name, args})` instead of the old `tool(name, payload)`. tests pass locally.
Miguel Sanchez: quick ask: when you update examples, can we include an explicit JSON-schema snippet for structured output? reviewers keep asking for a clear guardrail example.
Alex Kim: good point. i'll add a minimal schema and an example of parsing fallback.
Elaine Wu: also add a note about nullable fields — we had one customer hit that with tool outputs. a tiny sentence saves time.
Priya Nair: agreed. propose this tiny schema example:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string"},
    "params": {"type": ["object", "null"]}
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```
Sam Ortiz: looks good. add an inline example showing how to validate in python:```py
from jsonschema import validate, ValidationError
try:
  validate(instance=output, schema=SCHEMA)
except ValidationError:
  # fallback to generator-parsed default
  output = {"action": "unknown", "params": None}
```
Miguel Sanchez: for the docs page, can we surface the suggested fallback policy as a tiny checklist? e.g. validate -> if fail, try reparsing with relaxed schema -> if still fail, call fallback tool. keeps teams consistent.
Alex Kim: i'll add that checklist in the migration guide section. short bullets only.
Priya Nair: links: pls update existing internal links pointing to docs/tool-calling.md -> docs/snippets/tool-calling.md. i found two in the contributor guide.
Alex Kim: will search & replace in the repo and leave a note in the PR description with the changed file list.
Elaine Wu: reviewers: @Priya @Miguel can you both take a quick pass? i can take the examples wording.
Priya Nair: 👍 i'll review examples + schema wording.
Miguel Sanchez: i'll focus on the migration guide and the checklist.
Alex Kim: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/642 — includes snippet moves, schema example, and sdk call updates. summary in the PR body.
Sam Ortiz: small nit in the js snippet — use `await client.invokeTool()` instead of plain call. will open a one-line follow-up in the PR.
Alex Kim: thanks — i pushed the patch.
Docs Bot: PR 642 assigned to Priya Nair, Miguel Sanchez, Elaine Wu. CI: running checks.
deploy-bot: staging site build kicked: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/builds/3342
Priya Nair: CI failed on link-checker — encountered a moved anchor in docs/quickstart.md referencing `#tool-calling-examples`.
Alex Kim: ok i'll fix that anchor and push.
Alex Kim: pushed anchor fix.
Docs Bot: CI for PR 642 passed all checks.
Miguel Sanchez: LGTM from me for content and migration strategy. small suggestion: add a one-line explanation for why we pick `params` nullable (interop with older tools).
Alex Kim: added that sentence.
Elaine Wu: wording tweak: replace "fallback tool" with "fallback handler" to match our policy language.
Alex Kim: updated.
Priya Nair: final pass done. approving now.
Docs Bot: PR 642 merged into main by Alex Kim.
deploy-bot: site deployed to staging with PR 642 changes — preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/snippets/tool-calling/ (expires in 7 days) :rocket:
Sam Ortiz: quick follow-up — i'll sweep the SDK repo to ensure `invokeTool` is in the changelog.
Alex Kim: great. i'll file a small tracking issue for any downstream link updates found later.
Miguel Sanchez: thanks everyone — this should make onboarding for function-calling much smoother.
Elaine Wu: thanks! :tada:
